svg.title: Historical three-seed mean HM differences, independent HARP and LARP panels
svg.desc: All ten datasets and all signed mean differences versus route-specific R1 and R0; HARP original and selected policies are shown together. Unit percentage points. No route ranking, truncation, or inferred Novel trajectories.
svg.text: Independent methods and route-specific controls; descriptive comparisons, not cross-route rankings.
Filled = main/control; hollow = HARP original. Values in pp.
Mean ΔHM (percentage points; independent linear axis)
Only filled markers: main/control. Values in pp.
Mean ΔHM (percentage points; independent linear axis)
HARP: post-result EuroSAT seed2 selection is shown beside the still-valid original records. LARP R0 is an external historical reference.
No mean is clipped. Per-seed values and sample SD, including original failures/instability, are in main_comparison.md and summary.json.
